definitions.gloss: what on earth, what in the world
definitions.explanation: Used in questions to express surprise, confusion, or emphasis.
A single unified body or entity.

examples.japanese: {一体|いったい}{何|なに}が{起|お}きたの？
{一体|いったい}どこに{行|い}くつもりですか？
examples.english: Where in the world are you planning to go?

examples.japanese: {心身|しんしん}{一体|いったい}となる。
{一体|いったい}{誰|だれ}がこんなことをしたの？
チームが{一体|いったい}となって{戦|たたか}った。
examples.english: The team fought together as one.

examples.japanese: {一体|いったい}なぜそんなことをしたのですか。
examples.english: Why on earth did you do such a thing?

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}と{社員|しゃいん}が{一体|いったい}となって{頑張|がんば}った。
examples.english: The company and employees worked hard as one.

examples.japanese: {一体|いったい}いくらかかるの？
examples.english: How much on earth will it cost?

examples.japanese: {自然|しぜん}と{一体|いったい}になる{感|かん}じがする。
examples.english: I feel like becoming one with nature.

examples.japanese: {一体|いったい}どこで{習|なら}ったの？
examples.english: Where on earth did you learn that?

notes:
{一体|いったい} has two main uses: as an emphatic question word and as a noun meaning unity/body.

USAGE AS ADVERB:
- {一体|いったい} + question word ({何|なに}、どこ、{誰|だれ}、etc.)
- Adds emphasis or frustration to questions
- "What on earth," "who in the world," etc.

USAGE AS NOUN:
- {一体|いったい}となる (become one)
- {一体|いったい}{感|かん} (sense of unity)
- {心身|しんしん}{一体|いったい} (unity of mind and body)
